In summary, evidence indicates that the occasional use of NSAIDs does not impair muscle hypertrophy. Whether chronic NSAID administration is detrimental to muscle growth remains undetermined and likely is population specific: those with chronic low-grade inflammation might benefit from their use, whereas healthy, well-trained people could see long-term impairments.
